<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Entity text">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Main root element comment -->
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing &ent; and tags <foo> ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Basic description">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; with extra details">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ATTLIST item cat CDATA #REQUIRED>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="compiler" data="optimize=true"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Inventory item comment block -->
  <item cat="hardware">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with <tags> & references.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item cat="software">&extended;</item>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "Default Publisher">
  <!ENTITY % dtdmacro "<!ENTITY complex \"&pub; - Expanded\">">
  %dtdmacro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-info version="1.0" status="draft"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://catalog.org/meta">
  <!-- Catalog section comment -->
  <book meta:type="fiction">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block inside book element.
    ]]>
  </book>
  <book>&complex;</book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY section-ent "Section internal entity">
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ELEMENT internal (#PCDATA)>">
  %p-ent;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://doc.org/custom">
  <!-- Top comment outlining document layout -->
  <section custom:attr="value">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with markup like <section> and entities &section-ent;.
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&section-ent;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rec-ent "Record content">
  <!ENTITY rec-nested "&rec-ent; plus more">
  <!ENTITY % meta-macro "<!ATTLIST record id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %meta-macro;
  <!NOTATION xml-notif SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY ext-res SYSTEM "external.xml" NDATA xml-notif>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="archive.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:ext="http://archive.org/ext">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <record id="r1" ext:source="internal">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed character data <record>&rec-nested;</record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record id="r2">&rec-nested;</record>
</archive>
```
